articles.summary: Universal Corporation (NYSE:UVV) (“Universal” or the “Company”), a global business-to-business agriproducts company, today announced financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Preston D. Wigner, Chairman, President, and Chief Executive Officer of Universal, stated, “Our market leadership and century of experience have positioned us well to navigate the current tobacco market dynamics. Our first-half results reflect the slower timing of tobacco shipments due to this delayed oversupply cycle, and we enter the second half of fiscal year 2027 encouraged by the positioning of our tobacco business. Customer commitments are in line with our full-year sales plans, and uncommitted tobacco inventories are within our target range. We forecast shipments to be heavily weighted to the second half of our fiscal year 2027, consistent with our plans and with historical patterns. articles.summary: Universal Corporation (NYSE:UVV), a global business-to-business agriproducts company, announced today that its Company's Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of eighty-three cents ($0.83) per share on the shares of the Company, payable February 1, 2027, to shareholders of record at the close of business on January 11, 2027. In addition, the Company announced that the Company’s Board of Directors has approved a program for the repurchase of up to $100 million of Universal Corporation shares of common stock. The authorized purchases may be made from time to time on the open market or in privately negotiated transactions at prices not exceeding prevailing market rates. Universal currently has approximately 24.9 million common shares outstanding. articles.summary: Universal Corporation (NYSE: UVV), a global business-to-business agriproducts company, today announced the appointment of Gregory R. Friedman to its Board of Directors (the “Board”), effective November 4, 2026. Mr. Friedman brings more than 30 years of financial, operational, and strategic leadership experience across global businesses to Universal. Most recently, he served as Chief Financial Officer of Mura Technology, an international plastic recycling technology company. Previously, Mr. Friedman served as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Corteva, Inc. (NYSE: CTVA), a global agriculture company, where he helped lead the company through its separation from DowDuPont and establishment as an independent publicly traded company, and played a key role in shaping its capital structure, financial policy, and investment priorities.
